# Feel Your Protocol — Phase 3 Roadmap

> Conceptualization workspace for Feel Your Protocol Phase 3: problem & vision, milestones,
> roadmap tracks, timeline, and draft outlines of core concepts (deterministic API & MCP for the
> future Ethereum protocol — upcoming forks, EIPs, and research; x402, pricing/cost model) and
> infrastructure. Nothing here documents a shipped API yet — it records where thinking stands
> a shipped API yet — it records where thinking stands today, including open questions.

The explorations website (feelyourprotocol.org) is the front door; this roadmap site is the
organizational home for where the project is headed. The FYP community token is intended as a
volume discount on future API usage, not a gate. Educational, open-source character throughout.

## Vision

- [Problem & Vision](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/vision/problem-vision.html): Why a deterministic oracle for upcoming protocol changes; about this site
- [Two Legs](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/vision/two-legs.html): Explorations website + future-protocol API/MCP as complementary legs

## Roadmap

- [Roadmap Board](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/roadmap/roadmap.html): Tracks and horizons (data-driven board)
- [Timeline](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/roadmap/timeline.html): Project phases and milestones

## Concepts (draft)

- [Agent API & MCP](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/concepts/api-mcp.html): Target-state sketch for simulating future fork rules and EIPs
- [x402](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/concepts/x402.html): Payment rails concept for agent usage

## Monetization & infra

- [Token role](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/monetization/token.html): FYP as volume discount, not gate
- [Pricing](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/monetization/pricing.html): Draft cost model
- [AWS / hosting](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/infrastructure/aws.html): Strato vs cloud for API MVP
- [Distribution](https://roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org/go-to-market/distribution.html): Go-to-market notes

## Related

- [Main site](https://feelyourprotocol.org/): Interactive Ethereum protocol explorations
- [Website Docs](https://website-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/index.html): Contributor guide and architecture
- [MCP Docs](https://mcp-docs.feelyourprotocol.org/): Concrete MCP server reference (as capabilities ship)
- [Community Token](https://community-token.feelyourprotocol.org/): Transparency page for FYP on Base
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/feelyourprotocol/website): Roadmap content lives in the `roadmap/` folder

## Notes

- Built with VitePress; static HTML on roadmap.feelyourprotocol.org after deploy.
- Board and timeline are data-driven (`roadmap/data/roadmap.ts`, `roadmap/data/timeline.ts`).
- Conceptualization only — not financial advice; not affiliated with the Ethereum Foundation.
